announcements.text: Sea Box Inc.,* Cinnaminson, New Jersey, was awarded a $216,364,156 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite contract for one-sided expandable shelters supporting the Armament Repair Shop Set and Metal Working and Machining Shop Set programs. The shelters will serve as base housing units for the individual sets. Bids were solicited via the internet with eight received. Work locations and funding will be determined with each order, with an estimated completion date of Nov. 21, 2031. Army Contracting Command, Detroit Arsenal, Michigan, is the contracting activity (W912CH-27-D-A104).

announcements.text: The Boeing Co., Ridley Park, Pennsylvania, is being awarded a $197,279,932 firm-fixed-price order (W91215-16-G-0001 H9224126FE001) modification for procurement of MH47G rotary wing aircraft in support of U.S. Special Operations Command. announcements.text: Sabre Systems LLC,* Lexington Park, Maryland, is awarded a $155,686,008 cost-plus-fixed-fee, cost modification (P00010) to a previously awarded indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract. This modification increases the contract's labor-cost ceiling by $155,686,008, from $499,923,342 to $655,609,350, with no increase to fee, to continue systems engineering, research and development, technical baseline, and engineering assessment support for Naval Air Systems Command program offices. Work will be performed in Lexington Park, Maryland (40%); Patuxent River, Maryland (30%); and various locations within the continental U.S. (30%), and is expected to be completed in April 2030. No funds will be obligated at the time of award; funds will be obligated on individual orders as they are issued. The initial contract was competitively procured. Naval Air Warfare Center, Aircraft Division, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems, Moorestown, New Jersey, is awarded a $47,940,933 cost-plus-award-fee, cost-plus-fixed-fee type modification to previously awarded contract (N0002423C5117) to exercise option items supporting systems engineering and software integration for the integrated combat system across the Surface Force portfolio of the Navy and Coast Guard. Work will be performed in Moorestown, New Jersey (41%); Columbia, Maryland (30%); Norfolk, Virginia (7%); Middletown, Rhode Island (6%); College Park, Maryland (5%); Mount Laurel, New Jersey (4%); Huntsville, Alabama (3%); Wallops Island, Virginia (1%); Arlington, Virginia (1%); San Diego, California (1%); and Herndon, Virginia (1%), and is expected to be completed by September 2027. Fiscal 2026 research, development, test and evaluation (Navy) funds in the amount of $13,364,817 (46%); fiscal 2027 research, development, test and evaluation (Navy) funds in the amount of $8,829,010 (30%); fiscal 2026 operations maintenance (Navy) funds in the amount of $4,300,000 (15%); fiscal 2026 weapons procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $2,700,000 (9%); and fiscal 2025 research, development, test and evaluation (Navy) funds in the amount of $33,000 (<1%), will be obligated at time of award of which, $13,364,817 will expire at the end of the current fiscal year. PAE Mission Systems, Arlington, Virginia, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: DRS Systems Inc., Melbourne, Florida, is awarded a $19,783,659 firm-fixed-price order (N0001927F1006) against previously issued basic ordering agreement (N0001924G0001). This order procures five far field test stations, two fiber optic cable assembly kits for AH-1Z integration, four fiber adapter sets, two laser two assemblies, eight laser two sources, and associated hardware and data deliverables to expand testing capacity in support of the Navy's Distributed Aperture Infrared Countermeasure system. Work will be performed in San Diego, California (60%); and Dallas, Texas (40%), and is expected to be completed in November 2027. Fiscal 2027 aircraft procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $18,107,705; and fiscal 2026 research, development, test and evaluation (Navy) funds in the amount of $1,675,954, will be obligated at the time of award. This order was not competitively procured. Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity.
